description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the land in Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2085/22, Mahara D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters, specifically providing notices under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding statutory compensation deposits for acquired lands. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land parcels (including lot numbers, land names, extents, and compensation amounts) in the Colombo District, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
